title: Da Nang Family Getaway
author: Huyen Nguyen
description: Sunny Da Nang hotel by the beach

segments.text: Last summer, I traveled with my family to Da Nang
We stayed in a beautiful hotel near the beach
The hotel was quite luxurious with amazing facilities
It had a swimming pool and a great restaurant
We enjoyed long walks along the sunny shoreline daily
The trip created wonderful memories that we will treasure
